api_changes.detail: The quickstart shows POST https://api.together.ai/v1/chat/completions and an OpenAI client base_url of https://api.together.ai/v1. This sample only changes the model field.

code_change.before:
from openai import OpenAI
client = OpenAI(base_url="https://api.together.ai/v1")
response = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small",
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Hello"}],
)
code_change.after:
from openai import OpenAI
client = OpenAI(base_url="https://api.together.ai/v1")
response = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="zai-org/GLM-5.3-Flash",
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Hello"}],
)

migration_checklist: Read the shutdown date for thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small on the linked official page.
This date is the serverless inference removal on the Together deprecations page.
Point your requests at zai-org/GLM-5.3-Flash and test before you send traffic.
